这个街区连接在环网的一个节点上。压力取决于地面高程、邻接管道的损失，以及此刻整个: This district joins one node of the looped network. Its pressure depends on elevation, neighbouring pipe losses and the whole city's consumption.
点任一街角的铜色节点，查看当地水压、水龄和供水。: Select a copper street-corner node to read local pressure, age and delivered flow.
改变一个地方，观察储水、流向与每个街区的压力。模拟会继续，不会替你重置。: Change one part and watch storage, flow directions and district pressures. The simulation keeps its history.
换一个条件，重新看这座城: Change a condition. Read the city again.
三份可重玩的调度任务。它们会重新布置水量和时间，你仍可自由转动镜头、开关阀门与调: Three replayable dispatch experiments reset water stocks and time. You can still orbit, operate valves and change your strategy.
早高峰前，只剩 240 m³ 高位储水。试着靠节水撑过一小时；恢复供电会结束这次: Before the morning peak, only 240 m³ remains aloft. Conserve water to last an hour. Restoring power ends this outage condition.
从清晨六点开始，连续两小时满足至少 92% 需求。调泵、补水，也可以让城市少用一: Start at 06:00 and supply at least 92% of demand for two hours. Adjust pumping and production, or let the city consume less.
城市有一处破管。沿着水流和压力找到它，点街角节点修复，再看管网怎样恢复。: A pipe is leaking. Follow flows and pressure to find it. Select the street-corner node to repair it and watch recovery.
也可以直接点任意管道，再单独关闭或打开它。: You can also select any pipe and close or reopen it individually.
原创参考城市。采用定摩阻 Darcy–Weisbach、压力相关供水、泵曲线、储: An original reference town: fixed-friction Darcy–Weisbach losses, pressure-dependent delivery, a pump curve, storage balance and four-cell upwind transport. Water hammer, building plumbing, wall reactions and pathogens are omitted. Geometry, treatment, demands and reaction coefficients are illustrative.
一座城怎样喝到水: How a city gets its water
雨水先存起来。水位决定取水口还剩多少余量；水库不是无限水源。改变来水，再把时间拨: Rain is stored before it is used. The stock determines how long intake can continue. Change the inflow, accelerate time and discover how long the city can live on its reserve.
格栅拦住漂浮物，原水经过管道进入水厂。这里的取水量受闸门、水源余量和滤池运行状态: Screens stop floating debris before raw water enters the works. The gate, remaining source water and filter availability jointly limit the intake rate here.
混凝剂帮助细小颗粒脱稳，慢搅拌让它们碰撞成较大的絮体。旋转桨叶与颗粒只作过程示意: Coagulant destabilises fine particles; gentle mixing helps them collide into larger flocs. Blades and particles illustrate the process. The dose–turbidity relation is a teaching response curve.
流速放缓，絮体在重力下沉降，刮泥机把底部污泥收走。清水从堰口继续流向滤池。沉淀不: As the flow slows, flocs settle under gravity and a rake collects sludge. Water over the weir continues to the filters. Settling alone cannot complete treatment.
水向下流过滤料，截留剩余悬浮颗粒。运行越久，滤层负荷越高；反冲洗暂时降低产水量，: Water passes downward through media, retaining remaining suspended particles. Load builds as filters operate. Backwashing temporarily reduces production while restoring the filter.
留下沿途继续作用的余量: Leave a residual for the journey
折返的廊道延长接触时间。这里用完全混合与一阶衰减追踪一个代表性余氯信号，不计算病: Baffled passages extend contact time. This model tracks a representative chlorine signal through complete mixing and first-order decay. It does not calculate pathogen inactivation or judge drinking safety.
水厂与城市之间的缓冲: A buffer between works and city
处理后的水先存进清水池。产水与供水不必每秒相等，水位会接住差额；持续抽得比处理得: Treated water first enters the clearwell. Production need not equal consumption every second: storage absorbs the difference. Keep pumping faster than treatment and the clearwell eventually empties.
泵用电能提高水头。转速越高，泵的关阀扬程按转速的平方变化；实际流量由泵曲线与整张: A pump adds head using electrical energy. Shutoff head changes with the square of relative speed; the pump curve and the entire network determine the actual flow together.
水面高于水龙头，就有静水压力。泵停下来以后，水塔仍能供水；直到储水耗尽。观察高峰: A water surface above a tap creates pressure by gravity. After pumps stop, the elevated tank can still supply water until its reserve runs out. Watch flow reverse at peak demand and pumping replenish it later.
用水需求随一天起伏。水压不足时，实际到达的流量会下降。每个节点都计算水头，每条管: Demand rises and falls through the day. When pressure falls, delivered flow decreases. Every junction has a solved head; every pipe has a signed flow.
这里和所有街区共用环状管网。打开消防用水、降低泵速或隔离一条干管，看看节点之间如: The hospital shares the same looped network. Open fire demand, lower pump speed or isolate a main and watch flow redistribute. Building-level plumbing is not separately solved.
工业用水叠加在街区需求上。环网能从不止一个方向供水，但冗余不是无限的；一处漏水会: Industrial use adds to district demand. A loop can feed a place from several directions, but redundancy has limits: one leak can change pressure and water age elsewhere.
